mapper.select: select id, user_id, profile_id, profile_version, dimension_key, status, correction_value_json, reject_reason, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, create_time, update_time from learner_profile_confirmation where user_id = #{userId} and profile_id = #{profileId} and profile_version = #{profileVersion} order by dimension_key
mapper.insert: insert into learner_profile_confirmation (user_id, profile_id, profile_version, dimension_key, status, correction_value_json, reject_reason, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{profileId}, #{profileVersion}, #{dimensionKey}, #{status}, #{correctionValueJson}, #{rejectReason}, #{confirmedBy}, #{confirmedAt}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update status = values(status), correction_value_json = values(correction_value_json), reject_reason = values(reject_reason), confirmed_by = values(confirmed_by), confirmed_at = values(confirmed_at), update_time = sysdate()
